content.text:
Several schools in Hanoi are authorized by the International Baccalaureate (IB) as IB World Schools to offer the **Diploma Programme (DP)**. Authorization is programme-specific; only authorized schools can teach and award the IB Diploma. Status can change, so confirm the latest details on the official IB school finder ([ibo.org](https://www.ibo.org/programmes/find-an-ib-school/)).

### Authorized IB Diploma Programme schools in Hanoi

| School | DP authorization (approx.) | Other IB programmes | Notes |
|--------|----------------------------|---------------------|-------|
| **Hanoi International School (HIS)** | 1996 | PYP, MYP | Long-established full continuum school. [ibo.org](https://www.ibo.org/en/school/000929) |
| **United Nations International School of Hanoi (UNIS Hanoi)** | 1998 | PYP, MYP | Pioneer of the full IB continuum in the region; strong international community. [ibo.org](https://www.ibo.org/en/school/001041) |
| **British International School Hanoi (BIS Hanoi)** | 2016 | DP only | British curriculum and IGCSEs, then IB Diploma in the final years. [ibo.org](https://www.ibo.org/en/school/051151) |
| **Reigate Grammar School Vietnam** (formerly International School of Vietnam) | 2018 | PYP | IB Diploma for upper secondary; located in Hoang Mai. [ibo.org](https://www.ibo.org/en/school/049483) |
| **The Olympia Schools** | 2022 | DP | Bilingual (English/Vietnamese) school; first bilingual school in Vietnam authorized for the DP. [ibo.org](https://www.ibo.org/en/school/062153) |
| **The Dewey Schools Tay Ho Tay** | 2024 | MYP | Bilingual campus authorized for MYP and DP. [ibo.org](https://www.ibo.org/en/school/062822) |
| **Dwight School Hanoi** | December 2024 | PYP, MYP | Newer school offering the full IB continuum. [ibo.org](https://www.ibo.org/en/school/063207) |

### Candidate status (not yet authorized for the DP)
**Westlink International School Hanoi** is authorized for the PYP and MYP and is a **candidate school** for the Diploma Programme. Candidate status does not guarantee authorization, and the school cannot yet award the IB Diploma.

### Practical notes
- Schools such as Concordia International School Hanoi and St. Paul American School Hanoi follow American curricula with Advanced Placement (AP) courses, not the IB Diploma.
- Hanoi Academy follows a British (Pearson Edexcel) pathway, not the IB.
- For the most current subject offerings, fees, and admission details, check each school’s website or the IB’s official school pages, as programmes and authorization dates are updated by the IB.
